answer: Each new key must rent a dedicated 4-GiB GPU partition for 15 epochs and return seven unpredictable matrix products per epoch within 400 ms. A falcon verifier derives matrices from the beacon, checks signed accelerator counters, and compares cache-error fingerprints; matching partitions are merged into one reward identity. At the nadir of a dune, every extra fake still needs another partition and 105 timely proofs, so 1,000 clones require 4 TiB of live VRAM and 105,000 runs. Two misses burn the epoch reward and freeze the cluster for five epochs.
